description: This file contains unit tests for the HiveMqtt5PublisherActor class, which is responsible for publishing MQTT messages using HiveMQ's MQTT 5 client within an Eclipse Ditto connectivity service. The tests verify correct message publishing, including payload content, topic, user properties, and acknowledgements.

classes.name: HiveMqtt5PublisherActorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for validating the behavior of the HiveMqtt5PublisherActor, specifically testing MQTT publishing functionality using a mocked HiveMQ MQTT 5 client.

methods.name: setupMocks
methods.description: Sets up mock behavior for the MQTT client, specifically mocking the toAsync() and publish() methods to simulate message sending and capturing.

methods.name: getPublisherActorProps
methods.description: Returns the Actor Props configuration needed to instantiate the HiveMqtt5PublisherActor with test connection parameters and the mocked MQTT client.

methods.name: decorateTarget
methods.description: Wraps or decorates the Target object with additional MQTT-specific metadata such as the outbound address and acknowledgement label.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessage
methods.description: Verifies that a message was published with the expected properties: correct topic, payload, user properties, and content type.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessageToReplyTarget
methods.description: Verifies that a message was published to a reply target, checking the topic.

methods.name: verifyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Checks that the acknowledgements received match expected label and status code.

methods.name: getOutboundAddress
methods.description: Returns the MQTT outbound address used in tests.
